snippet.title: GT Rivals: New Real Racing Simulator
snippet.description:
GT Rivals is an upcoming mobile racing simulator built around real cars, real tracks, and real competition.

Race online against real players, master licensed tracks, drive iconic cars, customize your build, and adapt to dynamic weather and time of day.
